sentences.text:
ON THE 7 th OF AUGUST, 2025  CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 325 of 2014  SURESH  Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH  Appearance:
 None for the appellant.
 Shri Rajendra Singh Suryavanshi appearing on behalf of  ORDER

This Criminal Appeal under Section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is preferred challenging the judgment dated 30.12.2013 in ST No.260/12 by the First Additional Session Judge,
Mandsaur whereby appellant/accused has been convicted under Sections 366A and 376(1) of the IPC and has respectively been sentenced to undergo 5 years R.I.; 7 years' R.I.; and to pay fine of Rs.3,000/- and 5,000/- with usual default stipulation.

2. This appeal arises out of the incident dated 08/04/2012 in which accused committed rape with the prosecutrix on the pretext of marriage and regarding which a Crime No.372/2014 was registered at Police Station Kukshi, District Dhar.

3. The PUD No.1116/Warrant/2025 dated 25.05.2025 of Superintendent, District Jail, Mandsaur mentions that the appellant/accused has been released on 16.03.2018 after completing the sentence and NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:21610 2 CRA-325-2014 depositing the fine amount.

4. Perusal of the prosecution evidence and judgment of the trial Court does not discloses any error in appreciation of evidence and conviction of the appellant/accused, hence, the conviction is affirmed.
The sentence is proportionate and that has been undergone, accordingly, no case for interference in the sentence is required.
5. In view of the aforesaid, this criminal appeal is dismissed.
6. Copy of the order along with record be sent to the concerned trial court for information.
